paymentShouldFail.description: demo-only failure-injection toggle to exercise saga compensation; production services MUST NOT expose debug hooks on the business wire — drive failures from real downstream responses

idempotencyKey.description: client-supplied idempotency key; the same key returns the same order without re-running the saga (Temporal workflow-id / DTM GID model). Must contain only ASCII letters, digits, and the separators ._- (no '/' or ':'): the derived orderID ('ord-'+key) is returned to the client and queried back as a single path segment via GET /api/v1/orders/{id}, so it must be a URL-path-segment-safe value (a subset of idutil.IsSafeID — '/' would split the segment and break the round-trip)
